releases.description: Vast Beta 0.2.5 is the current public Windows test build, with a flatter Dim interface, expanded Ctrl-K controls, and release infrastructure improvements.
notes: This beta is intentionally unsigned. Windows will show Unknown publisher and SmartScreen may warn.
Includes the Windows installer and a portable build.
The release includes SHA-256/SHA-512 checksums, exact-source metadata, updater artifacts, and FFmpeg corresponding source.

releases.description: Vast Beta 0.1.5 is the current official public test build for Windows. It is intended for early testing and direct community feedback.
notes: Early beta software may include unfinished features and unexpected issues.
This release is available as a Windows installer.
